selection.selection_rule: Direct source identity, access, duration, permanent deduplication and recent-topic gates precede weighted ranking.
selection.topic_diversity: The pool spans atmospheric data, sea-level measurement, communication norms, material culture, place-based history, astronomy and household innovation. The selected scale-and-data-literacy lesson is distinct from the prior seven days' plant acoustics, interface history, accelerators, nutrition labels, wartime markets, mystery TV and life design.

observed_fields: NOAA and U.S. Department of Commerce identity
scope_limitations: The page is a public explainer, not the latest National Climate Assessment.
Its 2015 record example is historical and was explicitly flagged as not current.
Estimated reading time was assessed from the three-part page; no user-specific reading speed was measured.

preflight.concurrent_head_changes: Journal publication advanced main twice during preparation. Current policy and English history hashes remained unchanged; the new Journal PREPARED record was read through the connector, targets were re-observed, and the English PREPARED commit used the fresh current parent/tree.

repository_validation.integrity: passed_local_checks; English 70 rows and 70 unique resources

historical_backlog.effect_on_current_english_publication: none; retained as historical failure evidence

historical_backlog.issue: three pre-policy duplicate ID groups remain retained and permanently blocked

limitations: Structural validation and CI do not certify teaching quality by themselves; the three notes were separately reviewed for task count, evidence boundaries, originality, vocabulary depth and pedagogy.
Live-source verification confirms the official page and inspected content, not every linked downstream report or real-time weather service.
No local Obsidian device synchronization or notification-delivery check was performed.
The final QA receipt commit cannot self-certify its own later GitHub Actions run without a circular follow-up mutation.
